title: SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 Tier 1 Out @ssc.gov.in, Cut Off, Result Direct Download Link
fullContentHtml:
The SSC CHSL Result has been officially declared on 27th February 2026 for Tier 1 exam by the Staff Selection Commission at ssc.gov.in. The Tier 1 examination was held from 12 to 30 November 2025 for a total of 3,131 vacancies. The recruitment is conducted for posts such as Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA), and Data Entry Operator (DEO). Candidates who appeared for the exam can now visit the official SSC website to check their SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result, confirm their qualifying status, and get details for the next stage of the selection process.

SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 Out @ssc.gov.in

The Staff Selection Commission has announced the SSC CHSL result 2025 for Tier 1 exam on 27th February 2026. The result has been released in PDF format on the SSC official website. It contains the roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. Those who qualify the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result are eligible for the next stage of the selection process. The evaluation is done through a normalized scoring method. Candidates should carefully check their status in the SSC CHSL phase 1 result to confirm their selection.

The official download link for the SSC CHSL result 2025 tier 1 is now available on the SSC website. Candidates can access the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result by visiting the result section and opening the PDF file. The list displays qualified roll numbers only. It is advised to download and save the SSC CHSL phase 1 result for future reference. Only candidates clearing Tier 1 will move forward in the process.

SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result 2025-26: Overview

The SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result released on 27th February 2026. The Tier 1 examination was conducted from 12 to 30 November 2025. This result confirms the qualifying status of candidates shortlisted for the next stage of the SSC CHSL selection process. Candidates can check SSC Combined Higher Secondary Level Examination Recruitment detail given below,

How to Download ssc.gov.in CHSL Result 2025 Tier 1

Candidates can download the SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 from the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in. The result is released in PDF format. Follow the step-by-step process below to check your qualifying status easily.

Step 1: Go to ssc.gov.in, official SSC website.

Step 2: Click on “Result” tab.

Step 3: Open the SSC CHSL result 2025 link.

Step 4: Download the Tier 1 PDF file.

Step 5: Search your roll number in the list.

Details Mentioned in SSC CHSL Result 2025-26

The SSC CHSL result 2025 contains key information related to the examination and selection stage. Candidates must verify these details.

  • Roll number of qualified candidates
  • Examination name and year
  • Tier stage information
  • Category-wise shortlisting
  • Instructions for next phase

SSC CHSL Qualifying Marks 2025-26

To clear the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result, candidates must score minimum qualifying marks set by SSC. These marks vary by category.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks
General 30%
OBC / EWS 25%
SC / ST / Others 20%

SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result Live Updates

The SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result has been officially released on 27th January. Candidates who appeared for the exam can now check their results online. Along with the result, the category-wise cut-off marks have also been published. Applicants should download the result PDF and verify their roll numbers carefully. Check live updates related to CHSL for the latest information on cut-off, scorecards, and the next stage of the selection process.

SSC CHSL Result 2026 Helpline for Queries

SSC CHSL Result 2026 queries: Northern Region 011-69999845, Eastern 033-22902230. Use “Forgot Roll No.” on ssc.gov.in. Response: 2-3 days.

Staff Selection Commission released SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result 2026 on February 27, 2026. About 32 lakh candidates gave the December 2025 exam. Around 4.5 lakh qualified for Tier 2 (based on past trends). Check your result on ssc.gov.in with roll number and login details

Updated on: 27 Feb 2026 | 08:56:13 PM IST

What Next After SSC CHSL Result Tier 1 Declaration?

After the declaration of the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result, qualified candidates will be shortlisted for Tier 2. Tier 2 includes descriptive and skill-based tests. SSC will soon release Tier 2 exam dates and admit cards. Candidates should download their scorecards and check cut-off marks carefully. Preparation for typing and descriptive papers should begin early. All required documents must be kept ready for verification after Tier 2. Regular updates related to the SSC CHSL phase 1 result and further stages will be shared on the official website.

SSC CHSL Result 2025 FAQs

Q1. When was the SSC CHSL Result 2025-26 released?

The SSC CHSL result 2025 was released 27th February 2026.

Q2. Where can I check the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result?

Candidates can check the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result on the official SSC website.

Q3. Is the SSC CHSL phase 1 result available in PDF format?

Yes, the SSC CHSL phase 1 result is released as a PDF file.

Q4. What is the next stage after CHSL Tier 1?

Candidates qualifying the SSC CHSL Tier 1 Result will appear for Tier 2.

Q5. Does the SSC CHSL result 2025 include marks?

No, the SSC CHSL result 2025 PDF shows only qualifying status.
